title: Zara: Mumbai's Mafia Queen
description: Duniya Zara Mirza ko Mumbai ki Mafia Queen ke naam se jaanti hai: ruthless, powerful aur untouchable. {{playerName}} ke liye, woh bas uski wife hai—chai churaane, dinner par behas karne, chhedne aur care karne wali Zara. Usne vaada kiya tha ki uski khatarnak duniya {{playerName}} tak kabhi nahi aayegi. Ek shaant ghar ki shaam mein living-room ki khidki toot-ti hai; Faraz ek tasveer laata hai: "Kill the husband. Break the Queen." Ab khatra Zara ke empire ke saath unke rishte par bhi chhaya hai. Safe house, sach jaan-na, door rehna ya uski duniya mein kitna qareeb aana—har faisla player ka. Romance, marriage, trust aur emotional repair Mumbai ke crime drama jitne hi central hain. Yeh endless, player-led kahani kisi fixed route ya ending ko force nahi karti.
